Agent Handoff

Product·by @jeetnirnejak·2026-08-27·inspora page·original post

What it is

Agent Handoff visualizer: a card showing 4 AI agents (Triage, Researcher, Writer, Reviewer) as icon nodes along a horizontal progress rail; a dot pulses along the rail as work hands off between agents, the active agent's icon lights up in its brand color while others grey out, and a 'HANDOFF LOG' beneath appends timestamped lines; Reset/Pause/Resume/Restart controls.

Media

Frame-by-frame

0-15%
Triage active (blue icon, colored dot at its node); log shows 'Run started: task assigned to Triage', 'parsing request intent'; bottom status 'Triage - classifying the request'.
15-35%
Handoff: dot slides along the rail from Triage to Researcher; Researcher icon ignites purple, Triage dims; log appends 'Triage -> Researcher: classified as research', 'querying Q2 ticket archive'; status line updates.
35-55%
Researcher -> Writer (orange icon); rail dot travels; log grows ('8 sources attached', 'drafting summary'); pause pressed mid-run: rail dot stops, controls swap Pause->Resume, 'Paused at 6.4s'.
55-80%
Resume; Writer -> Reviewer (green); rail fills with the gradient of completed segments (blue->purple->orange->green).
80-100%
Reviewer finishes ('running approval checks', 'verifying sign-off'); full rail colored end to end; Restart resets icons to grey, log clears.

Build prompt

Rebuild this interaction 1:1: an "Agent Handoff" visualizer - 4 AI agents (Triage, Researcher, Writer, Reviewer) as icon nodes on a horizontal progress rail. A dot pulses along the rail as work hands off between agents; the active agent's icon ignites in its brand color while others grey out; a HANDOFF LOG beneath appends timestamped lines. Reset / Pause / Resume / Restart controls.

## Stack
React + TypeScript + Tailwind + Framer Motion. Scripted state machine (phase index + timers, pausable). Animate transform and opacity only.

## Scene
Card: 4 agent icon nodes evenly spaced on a 2px rail (Triage blue, Researcher purple, Writer orange, Reviewer green - all grey when inactive). A traveling dot on the rail; completed rail segments fill with the passing agent's color (rail ends up a blue->purple->orange->green gradient). Below: HANDOFF LOG panel (mono 12px, appending lines). Bottom status line ("Triage - classifying the request"). Controls: Reset / Pause-Resume / Restart.

## Motion spec
Pattern: scripted simulation, restartable (not infinite).
- Agent phase ~1.5-2s: icon activates grey -> brand color with a spring pop (scale 1 -> 1.15 -> 1, 250ms); log lines append with 150ms stagger, each fading+rising (y 4 -> 0, 200ms).
- Handoff: dot travels between nodes over ~500ms ease-in-out; outgoing icon dims to grey as the incoming one ignites.
- Rail fill: segment behind the dot fills in the completed agent's color.
- Pause: dot halts mid-rail, controls swap Pause -> Resume, status shows "Paused at 6.4s". Resume continues.
- Finish: full rail colored end to end, final log lines ("running approval checks", "verifying sign-off"). Restart resets icons to grey and clears the log (200ms fade).

## Calibration
- Dot travel ~500ms ease-in-out between nodes; faster reads as teleporting.
- Icon activation spring is the only bounce in the piece - everything else is smooth.
- Log stagger 150ms; lines should feel appended by a process, not dumped.

## Reduced motion
Dot jumps between nodes with a 150ms fade; icons switch color without pop; log lines appear without motion.

## Don't miss
- Only one agent is colored at a time; the grey-to-brand ignition is the whole read.
- The rail accumulates each completed agent's color - it becomes the gradient of the run.
- Pause must freeze the dot mid-travel, not snap it to a node.
